subscription_id.description: Subscription GUID of the storage account. Required.

resource_group_name.description: Resource group of the storage account. Required. Alias: resource_group.

storage_account_name.description: Storage account name, without the .blob.core.windows.net suffix. Required. Alias: storage_account.

blob_name.description: Blob path inside the container, e.g. 'index.html' or 'edl/blocklist.txt'. Required. Alias: blob.

lines.description: Items to append, one per line. An array of strings, or a single newline-separated string. Items are trimmed; empty items are dropped; embedded newlines split into further lines. Alias: ips.

comment.description: Single comment appended to every line, separated by the CommentSeparator (' #' by default). A leading '#' in the comment is dropped so the separator is never doubled. Must not contain a newline.

skip_duplicates.description: Default true. Drops lines already present on the blob, comparing the part before the comment separator, so re-adding an address with a different comment counts as a duplicate. Set false to append unconditionally.

create_if_missing.description: Default false. When false a missing blob is a 404 — a typo in blob_name must not silently create a second blocklist. When true the blob is created first, as blob_type with content_type.

blob_type.description: BlockBlob (default) or AppendBlob. Used only when creating a missing blob; an existing blob keeps its own type.

content_type.description: Content type for a blob this call creates. Default text/plain. An existing blob keeps its stored content type.

dry_run.description: Default false. Resolves, reads and de-duplicates but writes nothing; appended_lines then means 'would append'.
